title: Mixed Event — One Small Trip Before a Big Journey — Episode8 Again, Sometime

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls first years are headed to Yokohama! Haruka realizes this field trip might be her last memory with her general education class before returning to the credit-based course. Saki asks to be in her group for the trip.

rows.Line: Yokohama

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The wind feels so nice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really does. Oh, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry for losing the hat. After all of you picked it out for me...

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it!
At least you won't have to worry about it flying away anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha, true! If it looks like you might get recognized again, we'll hide you with our bodies!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
Yeah! Leave it to us!
We should be able to hide you easily since you're slim, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't think it'll get to that level... But if it does, then I'll be counting on all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Despite some things happening midway, today was actually really fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure was! But to make up for the things we couldn't do today, let's go somewhere together again!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean by “somewhere”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, remember what we talked about at the curry place? We were wondering whether we get to go to Okinawa or Hokkaido for the school trip, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The school trip...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I won't be...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should all go together on our own first!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh?
Go together first?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's true. It's not like we can't travel there outside of a school trip. Going together, just us, sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Doesn't it? I mean, I can't wait until the school trip! If trips are this fun, then I want to go on lots of them♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's go in headfirst and jump on a ship or a plane like Ichi just before!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you think, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well... I think I might get busier with work, which could make planning more difficult...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even so, is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Saki and I will probably get busier with band stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: We'll be busy with club, so we're in the same boat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's make plans when we all have time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. In that case, we can go whenever it suits us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to come too. No matter where we go, I'm sure it'll be a fun trip if it's with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...?
Is something wrong, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Actually, there was something I've been meaning to say for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What was with that photo you two sent?! I can't believe you would send something like that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um, that was payback...
Besides, you and the others went to eat crepes without us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you ate our snacks! So pot, kettle!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I'm getting sidetracked!
It's so unfair that you got to take a selfie with Haruka! I want to be closer to Haruka too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Tenma, I thought that we were already quite close friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That! That right there, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been wondering about this forever! When will you call me by my first name?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Th-That's what you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, got it. I also want to be closer friends with all of you, so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's make more memories together, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-So bright!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki. You're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But... I'd also like it if you could call me by my first name.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. I'd like to make more memories with you too, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I think I understand how Minori feels now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See! I wasn't exaggerating at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But it makes me happy that we got to bridge that gap!
Can't wait to hang out with you more, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I feel the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thinking about this being the last school event I could participate in made me a little sad at the beginning, but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was having so much fun that I completely forgot.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This day is going to be one of my most precious memories.)
bgm_area00002
Nighttime
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for buying souvenirs for all of us, Haruka! You really didn't have to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was my pleasure. I'm sorry for visiting so late. I really wanted to see all of you, and the next thing I knew, I was here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, I see. So, how was it? Did you have fun?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I went on the water taxi and got to see a very beautiful view of the harbor from the ship's deck.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There was a huge variety of souvenirs as well. But I ended up going with these since the packaging was so pretty.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope you like them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This... Oh, it's chocolate shaped like a brick. The packaging is also super pretty!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! Looks so yummy! I want some.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's no need to rush. Haruka has bought enough for all of us♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, Haruka. I'll be sure to savor every bite.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you not having any, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm okay. I've been looking forward to the souvenirs too, but right now I'm just enjoying the look you have on your face♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? My face?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been smiling since the moment you got here, you know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's how I know you had such a fun time on your field trip, and now even I've started feeling happy too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
I really did have a lot of fun. When I was in Yokohama, and even now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Even after we all went home, we've kept messaging each other in the group chat.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh!
What are you all talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, I took a really cute photo with a friend, so all of us started talking about taking more photos together sometime.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to see the photo, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can I? Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Here it is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that's a really nice shot! The water is beautiful and your poses are so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You look like you're having so much fun! I can see it in the photo.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, yes. I did have a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, my friends suggested that we should go travel together again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even though I told them that I'll probably get busier with work, they said it's fine because they'll be busy too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And that...made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see... Your friends are so sweet!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, they really are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm...so glad that I switched to the general education course. Even if it was just for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Had I not done that, I don't think I would've ever been able to experience what I did or become close friends with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, I'd like to hear more about your friends. Could you tell me about what happened today in more detail?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It might be a long story, though. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, so today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm going to treasure the memories I made today.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even after I return to the credit-based course, I want to stay close friends with Ichika, Saki and everyone, so...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to savor this feeling for a bit longer.)
